name: Momose Ayumu
source:
Kensuke's girlfriend.

Just as she and Kensuke were about to begin living together following his entrance into university, they were struck by the unfortunate news that Kensuke was being transferred to another workplace.

Nevertheless, drawing on her naturally cheerful disposition, she bravely sends Kensuke off and resolves to stay behind and look after their home while he is away.

She has been devoted exclusively to Kensuke since childhood, and naturally, he was also her first sexual partner.

She has an ordinary level of interest in sex and sometimes takes the initiative in asking for it herself. However, she also believes that simply being able to sleep beside him is enough to make her happy.

She has a cheerful and gentle personality and is the kind of person everyone likes.

She is also athletic and belongs to her university's tennis club.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
